lines.text: Israelites in the wilderness find a man gathering wood on the Sabbath and bring him to Moses, Aaron, and the congregation, who place him in custody.
The LORD tells Moses that the man must surely be put to death.
The whole congregation takes the man outside the camp and burns him, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
God tells the Israelites to make bells for the corners of their garments, with a blue cord on each, to look at and remember His commandments.
God says they will obey and be holy, and that He is the LORD who brought them out of Egypt.
